title: 進路セミナーⅡ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar II
teachers:
NAKADA Masayuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Improve their character building using their own ideals.
(2) Apply themselves to a profession as engineers who have ningenryoku (in Japanese) and improve their strengths as innovators and who can think and act for themselves.
(3) Establish their own goals for going on to graduate school or finding a job as a plan for their career.
advice:
We will cover the following based on student's self-check, self-reflection, and career planning:
1. Introduction to graduate school and various companies
2. Self-check and analysis
3. Special presentations by professional human resource managers and graduate students

Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to check for various messages and materials in class.
Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts.

1. Be able to clearly explain career plans and goals to a third party.
2. Be able to clearly and specifically identify future employment destinations.
3. Be able to adequately promote yourself.
achievementLevels.standard:
1. You can explain your career plans and goals to a third party.
2. You can clarify your future employment goals.
3. You can promote yourself.
